full_query: Can I take nyquil and benedryl at the same time?

shared_context.topic: taking NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time

sentences: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time is generally not recommended due to the risk of increased side effects and potential for overdose
Both medications contain antihistamines, which can lead to excessive sedation, dizziness, and impaired coordination when taken together
NyQuil typically contains doxylamine, an antihistamine, while Benadryl contains diphenhydramine, another antihistamine
Combining these can enhance the sedative effects and increase the risk of side effects such as dry mouth, urinary retention, and confusion, especially in older adults

If you are considering taking both medications, it is important to consult with a healthcare provider to ensure it is safe based on your individual health conditions and other medications you may be taking
